name: Regent Hong Kong
positioning: Harbourfront hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, with rooms and suites designed by Chi Wing Lo and restaurants including Nobu Hong Kong, The Steak House and Harbourside
best_for: Travelers who want rooms with Victoria Harbour views
Suite guests who want Regent Club access
Food lovers who want several restaurants and a bar under one roof

facts.text: The hotel is in Tsim Sha Tsui and offers suites with harbour views.
The hotel is at 18 Salisbury Road, Kowloon, Hong Kong.
Rooms and suites are designed by Chi Wing Lo.
Rooms have a windowfront daybed facing the harbour views.
Bath rituals use Perricone MD products.
Harbourview and Seaview Suites include access to Regent Club.
Suite stays include laundry of three items per stay, a locally inspired welcome snack, selected beverages and local beer.
Regent Club offers breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails, plus in-room check-in.
The Steak House grills prime meat on its original charcoal grill and has a salad bar.
Nobu Hong Kong serves the Japanese cuisine of chef Nobu Matsuhisa.
Harbourside serves breakfast, lunch and dinner buffets of Asian and Western cuisine at the edge of Victoria Harbour.
The Lobby Lounge has panoramic views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong Island skyline and serves afternoon tea.

highlights.text: In the Oasis Bathroom, a sliding door reveals a framed view of the harbour from the bath, and a moongate leads to the bath and shower.
The duplex Presidential Suite has a private rooftop terrace and infinity swimming pool with views of Victoria Harbour.
Regent Club, designed by Chi Wing Lo, is raised like a ship's bridge over The Lobby Lounge on the harbour side.
Qura Bar has a lounge, a bar and a cigar room with Art Deco and vintage accents.
The entrance has a cascading fountain leading to a passageway of golden LiuLi-inspired glass.

considerations.text: Children under 12 are not permitted at Qura Bar.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy tourist area with high foot traffic.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the five-star positioning.
